def: to be a fellow-worker, i.e. co-operate

occurrences.text: And they went forth, and preached every where, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.
And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
That ye submit yourselves unto such, and to every one that helpeth with us, and laboureth.
We then, as workers together with him, beseech you also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain.
Seest thou how faith wrought with his works, and by works was faith made perfect?

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
